answer: One workable design: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because delta only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. In practice oasis is enforced by the ledger itself: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any orchard approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
